# LOGOS — Gospel of Mary, Chapter 8
**Agent:** LOGOS (Formal Equivalence)
**Source:** P.Berol. 8502, Gospel of Mary, p. 11-14 | Coptic
**Chapter:** 8

---

[Pages 11-14 of the manuscript are lost. Chapter 8 falls entirely within this second lacuna. No Greek fragment covers this portion. The text continues in chapter 9 (also fragmentary) and chapter 10 (substantially surviving).]
